title: Workflow Step Payload Envelope v1
description: The immutable on-disk envelope for one run-scoped workflow-step handoff payload (v0.1.30 Item 5). Written atomically under .dadaia/runs/lifecycle/<run_id>/steps/<NNN>-<step>-attempt-<n>.step-payload.json — the DATA plane of the workflow-step handoff system. The LifecycleRun.workflow_steps ledger (control plane) addresses these envelopes by (run_id, producer_step, attempt). This is a NEW, separate schema; the generic handoff-v1.1 schema is never mutated. The 'payload' object is validated separately against the named output_schema (Python validators this release; per-schema JSON Schema files follow incrementally).

schema_version.description: Envelope schema version identifier. Must equal 'workflow-step-payload-v1'.

run_id.description: The LifecycleRun id this payload belongs to. Part of the addressable key.

producer_step.description: The workflow step that produced this payload (e.g. 'release_scope', 'qa'). Part of the addressable key.

attempt.description: Zero-based attempt number of the producer step. Part of the addressable key; distinguishes implement#2 from implement#1 (A24).

output_schema.description: The named payload schema the 'payload' object conforms to (e.g. 'release-scope-handoff-v1'). The resolver validates 'payload' against this named contract.

produced_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp ending in Z when the payload was produced.

retention_mode.description: How this payload is retained: delete-after-consumed (transient prompt-to-prompt, default), promote-to-evidence (review verdicts / consumed_backlog ledger, durable), keep-until-failure-ttl (failed/blocked-run investigation).

declared_consumers.description: The downstream step names that have declared a 'consumes' edge on this payload. A payload is cleanup-eligible only once every declared consumer has consumed it (A22).

payload.description: The named handoff payload body, validated separately against 'output_schema'. The envelope only requires it to be an object; its inner shape is the named schema's contract.
